limitations.tdr_guarantee_note: This profile is measurement provenance and Host policy input. It is not a GPU watchdog/TDR certificate. A measured workload does not guarantee safe execution for workloads outside its recorded envelope.

completion_requirements: Set target_fps within the requirements range 3..40 and record target GPU Tick / CPU Submission time budgets before measurement.
Set positive required_performance_headroom_fraction and required_memory_headroom_fraction values below 1 before measurement; set minimum_measurement_runs to a positive integer.
Measure every candidate as a complete workload tuple on the exact adapter / driver / OS / Runtime / shader identity. Preserve all trial rows and raw artifacts.
Select one passing source_trial_id. The top-level workload_envelope, summary measurements and selected Hard Limits must be taken from that same trial; never compose maxima from different trials.
Verify p95 frame / CPU Submission, maximum GPU Tick and peak local memory against the declared budgets after headroom.
Reject the profile if any correctness test fails, Work remains silently dropped, or quality / substep / iteration / collision scope is reduced.
Verify profile identity against the active environment before passing selected numeric limits to runtime_desc.
Record a detached SHA-256 for the canonical profile artifact. Do not place a self-referential checksum inside the hashed JSON.
Do not describe the profile or the two Hard Limits as a GPU watchdog / TDR prevention guarantee.
Use hard_limit_selection_mode=measured_maximum by default. Select lower values only with host_conservative_override and a recorded reason in host_policy.notes.
Record exact test_scene_ids in every calibration trial and require the selected trial to contain every required_test_scene_ids entry.

rules.target_fps: Required, 3 <= target_fps <= 40 as specified by requirements.md. target_frame_time_ms is derived as 1000 / target_fps.
rules.timing: For the selected trial, p95 frame time <= target_frame_time_ms * (1 - required_performance_headroom_fraction); maximum GPU Physics Tick time <= target_gpu_tick_time_ms_max * (1 - required_performance_headroom_fraction); and p95 CPU Submission time <= target_cpu_submission_time_ms_p95_max * (1 - required_performance_headroom_fraction).
rules.memory: peak_skin_physics_gpu_bytes + host_reserved_gpu_bytes <= dxgi_local_memory_budget_bytes * (1 - required_memory_headroom_fraction). If the DXGI budget is unavailable or changes during the measurement, the trial is not qualified.
rules.sample_count: selected trial run_count >= minimum_measurement_runs. The required count and headroom fractions must be declared before running measurements; no implicit default is permitted.
rules.workload: Every target_workload_envelope dimension must be <= the corresponding workload dimension in the selected trial. The top-level workload_envelope and measurements summary must match that selected_source_trial_id exactly; do not combine maximum values from separate trials. Each calibration_trials row must conform to calibration_trial_schema. Every required_test_scene_ids entry must exist in the selected trial's test_scene_ids.
rules.limits: In measured_maximum mode, selected_maximum_world_substeps_hard_limit must equal selected_source_trial.workload.tested_maximum_world_substeps and selected_maximum_integration_segments_per_tick_hard_limit must equal selected_source_trial.workload.tested_maximum_integration_segments_per_tick. In host_conservative_override mode, each selected value may be lower only; a non-empty host_policy.notes must justify the override and have been recorded before deployment. Neither value may exceed the matching tested value. Selected vertex / tetrahedron / cloth constraint / candidate / contact / iteration / resource caps must also be <= that same trial's tested values.
rules.correctness: A trial is rejected if any correctness fixture fails, any Work Budget / Capacity / CCD block remains unresolved, any candidate or contact is silently dropped, or solver quality / substep / iteration / collision scope is reduced to meet the time budget.
rules.identity: The Host verifies Adapter LUID, Vendor / Device IDs, Driver Version, Windows Build, Runtime Build and Shader Package SHA-256 before applying selected limits.
rules.profile_status: status is qualified only after every required field and rule passes. status=not_qualified or template_not_measured must never provide Runtime Hard Limit values to runtime_desc.
rules.selection: Host must select exactly one passing selected_source_trial_id that covers every target_workload_envelope dimension and satisfies every timing / memory budget. The default host_policy.hard_limit_selection_mode=measured_maximum uses that same trial's tested Substep / Segment maximum values exactly. A lower conservative override requires explicit mode and a non-empty reason in host_policy.notes. Never compose maxima across trials.

validation.selected_source_trial_id: must resolve to exactly one calibration_trials row
validation.target_workload_envelope: all workload dimensions are positive integers; a dimension may be zero only when the product policy explicitly declares it unused
validation.host_conservative_override: host_policy.notes is non-empty and records the pre-deployment reason for choosing lower values
validation.required_test_scene_ids: non-empty array of unique non-empty strings

calibration_trial_schema.trial_id: stable string identifier unique within this profile
calibration_trial_schema.run_count: integer; number of complete repeated runs with the same workload and build identity
calibration_trial_schema.dxgi_local_memory_budget_bytes: integer; must represent the sampled budget for all accepted runs
calibration_trial_schema.test_scene_ids: unique, non-empty strings naming the exact Gate R6 / acceptance scenes executed in this trial
